For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or changeover.

$XREFPROP=$XID={6100E4B8-28D4-4C6F-867F-0DB0E4205E4F}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={6100E4B8-28D4-4C6F-867F-0DB0E4205E4F}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

$XREFPROP=$XID={E3661284-5494-46E7-9921-16CD6BE0FFED}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={E3661284-5494-46E7-9921-16CD6BE0FFED}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than the capacity of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit.

$XREFPROP=$XID={A15D14F3-0A70-4D3E-9C3A-793B1755464A}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={A15D14F3-0A70-4D3E-9C3A-793B1755464A}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

When the seawater cooling system low supply alarm is triggered, the standby pump shall be capable of being started automatically or manually, or changeover to the standby pump shall be possible, to restore the cooling water supply.

$XREFPROP=$XID={3DD60FD6-7558-4A8D-B968-5DDBA6734BEC}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={3DD60FD6-7558-4A8D-B968-5DDBA6734BEC}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The sensor for the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be provided independently and shall be capable of continuously monitoring the seawater cooling water supply pressure or flow. The alarm signal shall be transmitted to the engine control system or alarm monitoring system.

$XREFPROP=$XID={C533C1B9-6C48-465B-9731-237F5C6D182C}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={C533C1B9-6C48-465B-9731-237F5C6D182C}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The threshold and actuation logic of the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be strictly limited to the corresponding manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration scope and shall not be generalized beyond that scope.

$XREFPROP=$XID={CFC48EF4-9CA4-4C7C-BC4C-837EF8D894F0}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={CFC48EF4-9CA4-4C7C-BC4C-837EF8D894F0}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;

01_Requirements
The seals, bearings, and motor of the cooling water pump shall be arranged so that they can be directly removed and installed without first moving unrelated piping or other equipment.

$XREFPROP=$XID={A3E341A2-E19F-405C-8A90-2EFDA8320B36}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={A3E341A2-E19F-405C-8A90-2EFDA8320B36}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements
Sufficient maintenance space shall be provided around the cooling water pump to facilitate removal and installation of the seals, bearings, and motor.

$XREFPROP=$XID={618BFEA3-FBA5-48E4-A3BF-C22EEE7DBE01}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={618BFEA3-FBA5-48E4-A3BF-C22EEE7DBE01}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The piping arrangement of the cooling water pump shall allow convenient access to the pump seals, bearings, and motor, and removal of these components shall not require moving a large amount of piping.

01_Requirements

The maintenance space for the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor shall meet the manufacturer's specified maintenance operation requirements, ensuring that maintenance can be performed without removing unrelated piping.

$XREFPROP=$XID={B919496D-4139-414B-AB5B-1B320E2B095B}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={B919496D-4139-414B-AB5B-1B320E2B095B}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={897E3223-8519-42CF-9ADD-7A1E2BA2869D}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={897E3223-8519-42CF-9ADD-7A1E2BA2869D}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The low-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 35°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 29-41°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={F33F5E5A-86E0-492C-AF63-907BE55C6467}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={F33F5E5A-86E0-492C-AF63-907BE55C6467}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={73C07339-D272-480B-972E-7A197247F255}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={73C07339-D272-480B-972E-7A197247F255}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure loss shall be 0.3-0.6 bar.

$XREFPROP=$XID={9ED95074-5F0B-4E17-A984-21F70AD468E9}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={9ED95074-5F0B-4E17-A984-21F70AD468E9}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.

$XREFPROP=$XID={6A2FBC17-E5D6-45C1-B69E-FE869E1FFE34}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={6A2FBC17-E5D6-45C1-B69E-FE869E1FFE34}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C, and the electronic water temperature controller shall identify deviations via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value.

$XREFPROP=$XID={0AA7F3DB-29D1-4B16-A67D-61463A4E8C0B}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={0AA7F3DB-29D1-4B16-A67D-61463A4E8C0B}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve.

$XREFPROP=$XID={95117929-FE0F-4965-8241-CA9F1A44BA30}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={95117929-FE0F-4965-8241-CA9F1A44BA30}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler.

$XREFPROP=$XID={0E05B96F-76F7-4785-B031-1C4C3883079B}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={0E05B96F-76F7-4785-B031-1C4C3883079B}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={D26A4728-46C9-4190-8268-87A7CEE7B106}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={D26A4728-46C9-4190-8268-87A7CEE7B106}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={F125E71E-BD1D-4D95-AC6B-049D48164719}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={F125E71E-BD1D-4D95-AC6B-049D48164719}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method of the cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control), and the maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment.
